storyCards.headline: Freeze Frame: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
The J. Geils Band's "Freeze Frame" reached #4 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #4 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 16 weeks on the chart.

Freeze Frame was released in 1982.
